survey:
The card shows a white astronaut helmet on a round collar, standing on a light grey metal shelf against a pink background. The camera is a little above the object and turned slightly to the right of it. Parts:
(1) The helmet is a sphere with a smooth round outline, which is correct for a sphere from any viewpoint. Its top-left is lit and the right side falls into shading.
(2) The amber visor is set into the front-left of the sphere and faces left of the camera. Its raised silver rim is an oval that follows the curve of the sphere: it is narrow at the left edge, which bulges slightly past the outline, and wider toward the right, where it ends in a tucked seam. That matches a visor turned partly away.
(3) The collar is a short upright cylinder with a silver top ring and a red stripe. It is seen from above. The top ring is an open ellipse, and the red stripe and bottom edge curve downward a little more strongly, as they should because they sit lower below eye level. The ellipses are level and the sides are vertical.
(4) The shelf is a flat top surface seen from above. Its back and front edges slope down toward the right and come closer together toward the left, which reads as a shelf turned at a slight angle and receding to one side. The two small rivets on the top sit flat on it.
(5) Contact: the collar's base sits flat on the shelf top, with a soft reflection and shadow under it. The base ellipse matches how steeply the shelf top is drawn. There is no floating or tilting against the surface.
The helmet, collar and shelf all agree on one camera.
